description:
Maitake gold mushroom extract | Shroom microdose capsules

Maitake gold mushroom extract Number of capsules: 120 cap

Capsule size: Size 0

Net Content Capsules: 400mg

Dosage: Take 1 – 2 capsules twice a day with water during the meal.

Maitake mushroom d fraction extract | Maitake Extract – 120 Capsules

Maitake (or Eikhaas/Grifola Frondosa) is a medicinal mushroom with a special reputation. This “King of Mushrooms” has been used in Japan for more than 3000 years. The fungus contains valuable nutrients and beta-glucans, making it one of the most popular superfoods at the moment.

The Maitake is indispensable as a supplement because of the nutrients, beta-glucans and fine properties present, among other things. McMyco Maitake capsules contain a powerful extract and are easy to take.

For extra effectiveness, this Maitake Resistance supplement has been enriched with Vitamin C and Zinc. Both Vitamin C and Zinc contribute to a good resistance and help the immune system.

Maitake Extract – 120 Capsules benefits:

– Stimulates the immune response.

– Improves metabolic health.

– Can inhibit cancer cells.

– May cause ovulation.

– Reduces oxidative stress

Ingredients per vegetarian capsule: 

Organic Maitake (Grifola Frondosa) extract of 100% fruiting body (sclerotia), standardized to 30% beta-glucans. It is a full spectrum extract obtain by means of H2O and ethanol. This is to get the most out of the fruiting bodies. Excipients: magnesium citrate and silicon dioxide.

Maitake gold mushroom extract Warning:

Keep out of reach of children.

Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have health problems.

This is a dietary supplement and should be use as such.
